apis.description: Which platform APIs to offer (ADR-0003). AppDatabase comes in a later module version.

appStorage.description: Blob storage with a keyless workload identity. Default: on where the profile allows public network access; profiles with private endpoints only (production) need private-endpoint support, which isn't implemented yet.

appCache.description: A cache (Valkey) in the app's namespace. Default: on where the profile's data.cache is inCluster; Azure Managed Redis (azureManagedRedis) needs private-endpoint support, which isn't implemented yet.
